title: コモンズ・オーク材
description: 木目の細かな暖色のオーク。家具・床・壁のベースカラーに。 ベースカラー画像のみ。Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
descriptionEn: Warm oak grain for furniture, floors and walls. Base color only. Set both axes to Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrapping. Opposite edges are not guaranteed to match under ordinary Repeat.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original AI-generated cafe texture, copied byte-for-byte from its recorded source
provenance.rights: Xenoah original image. On 2026-10-14 the owner authorized its publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party photograph or texture is included.
provenance.changes: Original PNG is unchanged. A separate resized WebP thumbnail and metadata were added. Original Mirror / mirrored-repeat sampling is retained.
provenance.generationBrief: Warm smoked medium oak timber with long fine vertical grain, broad quiet variations, narrow pores, low saturation golden-brown. NO plank joints, no knots larger than 1cm, no objects.

usage: Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
